Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the review of appeals in criminal cases.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reviewing appeals; and adding a new section tochapter 10.73 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.73 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any provision of rules of appellate procedure2.2(b)(2) and the rules for appeal of decisions of courts of limitedjurisdiction 2.2(b)(2), in a criminal case, the state of Washingtonmay, before jeopardy has attached, appeal as a matter of right adecision or order suppressing or excluding evidence, if the prosecutioncertifies to the trial court that the appeal is not taken for purposeof delay and that the evidence is a substantial proof of a factmaterial in the proceeding. (2) Failure to seek review as provided in subsection (1) of thissection shall not preclude the state of Washington from exercising anyother right of appeal or review established by the Constitution,statute, the rules of appellate procedure, or the rules for appeal of p. 1 HB 2716decisions of courts of limited jurisdiction.
